svg.aria-label: How a launch works: 1, log in with POST /rpc/WEBSES/create.asp; 2, fetch jviewer.jnlp and the BMC's own viewer jars; 3, launch the viewer on Java 8, wrapped by Fit, with media.c; 4, log out, always, even after a crash or a stop
